environment_findings: Controller MTP attempt stopped at user direction before requests; it is not a qualification result.
Windows source extraction required a long-path prefix.
Portable MSVC debug runtime was absent; PolyStrata uses its supported portable AVX2 release configuration.
CUDA 12.9 required CUDA_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=Shared to avoid mixing static and dynamic runtimes; the corrected llama plan performed two links and zero recompiles.
Loopback tests bypass the system proxy; console security regression passed with direct transport.

Initial llama MTP boundary failure was an ordinary-decode test assumption; native trace showed n_cached=4095 but stored=4094. The corrected fixture uses the evaluated frontier; no admission runtime change was needed.

The first PolyStrata MTP-enabled short-output fixture offered zero drafts and was not counted as speculative coverage. The final bounded longer-output fixture required and observed 157 offered and 123 accepted draft tokens.
